name: Sesame Shrimp Stir-Fry with Egg, Asparagus, Bok Choy, Edamame & Rice
ingredients: 1 ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; place in a medium bowl.
Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus; cut into 1-inch pieces and add to the bowl with the green onion.
Trim bok choy and cut crosswise into 1-inch strips; add to the bowl and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger; set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place eggs, salt, and pepper in another medium bowl; whisk to combine.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Pour eggs into the skillet; scramble using a combination of stirring and folding. Cook until eggs are no longer runny, 2-3 minutes. Remove eggs to a plate and set aside.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add shrimp, veggies, and edamame to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender and shrimp are cooked through, 5-7 minutes.
Return eggs to the skillet. Add soy sauce and sesame seeds; stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and shrimp stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
